name: 1social-tiktok
description: A TikTok posting workflow for the 1Social connector: write a short caption with the hook up front, check the video or photos against TikTok's rules, then publish now or schedule it.

interface.longDescription:
Post videos and photo carousels to TikTok without leaving the chat. Attach the clip or the photos, say what they are about, and get a short TikTok caption with the hook up front and a few hashtags. Before anything goes out the post is checked against TikTok's rules — it needs a video or photos, and photos must be JPEG — so a refused upload shows up here, not after publishing. Publish now or schedule it up to 30 days ahead in your own timezone.

Not only TikTok: the same 1Social account also posts to Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn, X, Threads and Bluesky.

After publishing you get a receipt that says whether the post actually landed. Anything still scheduled can be edited or cancelled from the chat.

Requires the 1Social connector ("Instagram & TikTok by 1Social"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a6eeddc84a08191af3e632007e03ba3 and sign in. You also need a TikTok account connected to your 1Social account.
capabilities: Also posts to Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn, X, Threads and Bluesky
